text: The FAA certified the G700 on 2024-03-29.
quote: including the G700 that received certification from the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration on March 29, 2024

text: Gulfstream began G700 deliveries in the second quarter of 2024, after FAA and EASA certification.
quote: including our ultra-long-range, ultra-large-cabin G700 aircraft, which began deliveries in the second quarter of 2024 following U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) certification.

text: The FAA and EASA type certified the G800 on 2025-04-16.
quote: On April 16, 2025, the world's longest-range business aircraft, our ultra-long-range, ultra-large-cabin G800 received type certification from the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and the European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA).

text: G800 deliveries began in the third quarter of 2025.
quote: Gulfstream aircraft deliveries, which included the G800 that began deliveries in the third quarter of 2025.

text: GD made three initial G800 deliveries in the third quarter and said the G800 would provide the majority of delivery growth in the fourth quarter.
quote: We also made three initial deliveries of the G800 in the quarter. This plane will provide the majority of delivery growth in Q4.

text: GD said additional G700 deliveries raised 2025 aircraft manufacturing revenue, and initial G800 deliveries largely offset lower G650 revenue as the G650 made its final deliveries.
quote: Aircraft manufacturing revenue increased in 2025 due to additional G700 deliveries. Initial deliveries of the new G800 largely offset the decrease in G650 revenue with its final deliveries in 2025.

text: The G500 entered service in 2018 and the G600 in 2019.
quote: The G500 and G600 entered service in 2018 and 2019, respectively.

text: G650 production ended in the first quarter of 2025, and the G800 replaces it.
quote: The G800 is the replacement aircraft for the G650, which correspondingly ended production in the first quarter of 2025.

text: The G650 made its final delivery in the second quarter of 2025.
quote: The G800 is the replacement aircraft for the G650, which had its final delivery in the second quarter of 2025.

text: GD said it phased out the G650ER and replaced it with the G800.
quote: As you know, we phased out the G650ER, and you're quite right, replaced by the G800.

text: Gulfstream builds all its large-cabin models in Savannah, Georgia, while a non-U.S. partner assembles the mid-cabin G280.
quote: Gulfstream designs, develops and manufactures aircraft in Savannah, Georgia, including all large-cabin models. The mid-cabin G280 is assembled by a non-U.S. partner.

text: Gulfstream's G280 certification release called the G280 a joint effort between Gulfstream and Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI).
quote: The G280, a joint effort between Gulfstream and Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI), offers the most comfortable cabin and the longest range at the fastest speed in its class.

text: GD reported delays at its Israel-based supplier of mid-cabin airframes, caused by conflicts in the Middle East.
quote: we have experienced some delays including at our Israel-based supplier of mid-cabin airframes caused by conflicts in the Middle East.

text: GD no longer estimates entry-into-service dates for new models, saying the regulators set the pace.
quote: I'm no longer in the business of estimating EIS given that the regulators set the pace.

text: Gulfstream introduced the G800 and the large-cabin G400 in October 2021.
quote: In October 2021, we introduced two new aircraft, the ultra-long-range, ultra-large-cabin G800 and large-cabin G400, completing a nearly two-decade effort to develop an all-new family of Gulfstream aircraft.

text: GD's backlog at 2021-12-31 included G400 and G800 orders, then scheduled to enter service in 2025 and 2023.
quote: Our December 31, 2021, backlog included orders for the new G400 and G800 aircraft, which are scheduled to enter service in 2025 and 2023, respectively.

text: GD said Aerospace operating margin should top 15% maybe in 2026 and surely in 2027, then degrade again in 2028 with the delivery of a significant number of G400s.
quote: operating margin and when it will move into the high teens, that is above 15%. The simple answer is maybe 2026, but for sure in 2027, with degradation again in 2028 with the delivery of a significant number of G400s.

text: GD said it has stepped up its work on the G400 and will say more over the next couple of quarters about where the G400 will be.
quote: On the 400, we've whipped up our efforts on the 400, and we'll have more to say over the next couple of quarters about where we think the 400 will be
